castra.name: Castra Ferrea
castra.examine: A waystation of the cursus publicus on the road out of the fort: a stable, a milestone, a man with a ledger.

portus.name: Portus Salis
portus.examine: The post station at the harbour road's end. The horses smell the sea.

vipasca.name: Vipasca
vipasca.examine: The mining town's post station, thick with red dust.

limes.name: the limes
limes.examine: The last post station before the frontier. The riders here don't ask where you're going.

circus.name: the circus road
circus.examine: A post station on the circus road, busy on race days.
